name: Irongate Combat & Augmentation Training Dojos
description: Irongate operates a tiered network of aug-compatible combat training facilities, from Tier 2 community dojos with basic sparring rings and second-hand resistance hardware to Tier 4 flagship centers with full neural-reflex calibration suites, licensed aug-integration coaches, and private combat simulation pods. The curriculum blends martial traditions from across the global diaspora — muay thai, sambo, capoeira, silat, systema — with augmentation integration theory: how to fight with chrome, against chrome, and through chrome. Irongate's Shelf-adjacent locations double as informal community centers.
story_hooks: A Tier 4 client training at a flagship Irongate center realizes their private sparring data is being used to calibrate an enforcement aug-system without their consent.
A legendary retired combat instructor resurfaces to run a Shelf Irongate location, and former students from very different backgrounds converge on the same dojo with conflicting agendas.
A character tracking a missing person finds their last known location is an Irongate facility — and the security footage from that night has been professionally erased.
